answers.what: Deeper is a free add-on for AI chat tools that helps you ask better, more expert-style questions.
answers.does: It rewrites your request into a more detailed prompt, including what to use and how to check the result. It shows you the rewritten prompt and waits for your approval before anything runs.
answers.who: It seems aimed at anyone who uses ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini and wants a fuller, more useful answer; the video also mentions coding tools.
answers.next: Go to deeper.tools/start, copy its instructions into your AI chat, then type “/deeper” followed by your request.
